Rhea: Heads-up: SilverMap wants a 3-week POC for 'silvermap-13b-lite' (customer-tuned) — they want a 4-bit quant variant, embeddings, and strict SSO + BYOK. They asked for p95 < 280ms at 40 qps bursts. Can SE/Infra confirm viability and any blockers?
Otis: Quick checks: 13B->4-bit usually doable but conversion depends on custom fused ops and tokenizer. Ask for tokenizer.json + 200 sample queries (mix short/long) + model weights or a provenance hash.
Leah: Security: BYOK + SAML supported. Need signed DPA and SOC2 evidence. For Hosted we can enable dedicated tenancy + KMS proxy. If they want Private in their VPC, estimate 2.5 weeks onboarding.
Marco: Perf: 40 qps bursts + p95<280ms for 100-token queries is tight. Recommend Dedicated baseline 3x A100-80GB with autoscale to 6 for sustained peaks; separate pool for embeddings with larger batch sizes.
Nolan: Commercial: I'll prepare two quotes: Hosted Dedicated POC (30d trial) and Private onboarding + monthly. Back-of-envelope for Dedicated fleet + BYOK ~ $48k/mo committed; final depends on token counts.
Rhea: Action items: 1) request artifacts (Otis) 2) SE run conversion + perf sweep (Otis/Marco) 3) security sign-off (Leah) 4) pricing (Nolan).
Otis: Perf command I'll run once assets arrive:
```
python perf_sweep.py --model silvermap-13b-4bit --ctx 128 --batch 1 --steps 200
```
Will capture p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec. Expect first numbers within 48h of assets.
Leah: Also ask customer which region (US/EU) for audit logs. Retention length affects cost and whether we suggest Private.
sec-bot: note: require BAA & signed DPA for any PHI; if they push PHI through the POC, Private is recommended.
Nolan: I'll include a line item for log-retention options (30/90/365) in the quote.
Rhea: I'll send the asset request and schedule a tech sync Thurs. Otis, flag any model-specific conversion issues if you see them.
Otis: Will do. If tokenizer has many OOV tokens we may recommend a tokenizer patch or mapping — that will change token counts and cost.
billing-bot: Ticket INF-4999 created for SilverMap POC, assigned to Otis (ml-eng), Marco (infra), Leah (security). Due 2026-04-18.
Rhea: Thanks all. I'll update customer after tech sync. :thumbsup:
